rows.description: At the prayers and gathering, relatives sit together and cook and cry. I feel held by the group even if I do not understand. Rituals help me see death as something families face together and survive.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: fear, gratitude, grief
related mind states: sadness

rows.description: I remember Dada giving me sweets and telling me stories. I feel warm and sad together. A wise adult helps me draw or tell a story about him. Love stays after someone goes, and remembering is a good thing.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: acceptance, fear, grief
related mind states: affection, gratitude, sadness

rows.description: I ask "will you die too, Mummy?" and feel frightened at night. Honest calm answers help: most people live a long time and I will be looked after. Hiding the question or lying about death makes the fear bigger.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: acceptance, gratitude, grief
related mind states: fear, calm

rows.description: At Diwali or Eid or Christmas I wear new clothes and feel part of something big. The lights, songs and food make me happy. Festivals teach that I belong to a family and community with shared stories.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: envy
related mind states: joy, nostalgia

rows.description: I play with my cousins all night and laugh until my tummy hurts. I feel pure joy. Shared celebration builds bonds. A wise adult makes sure quieter children are included in the fun.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: acceptance, envy
related mind states: joy, amusement, playfulness, hurt

rows.description: My cousin has bigger fireworks or fancier clothes and I feel a sting. I may sulk. A wise parent says "it is okay to wish, we have what we have and I love you". Comparing new things with others starts young.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: acceptance
related mind states: affection, envy

rows.description: The neighbour gives me sweets and greets me warmly at their festival. I feel welcome and curious about their customs. Seeing that different families celebrate differently teaches respect early.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: acceptance, envy
related mind states: admiration, curiosity

rows.description: I am asked to touch elders' feet or sit quietly in a long puja. I feel bored and a bit restless. Wise parents give me a small role and explain simply why. Rituals mean more if a child can join with understanding.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: acceptance, envy
related mind states: boredom

rows.description: I believe God is watching and will be angry if I am naughty. I feel worried about wrongdoing. A wise family also stresses God's kindness and forgiveness. Using fear of God to control a child can leave anxiety.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: curiosity, gratitude, worship
related mind states: anger, fear, anxiety

rows.description: Before eating I fold my hands and say thank you for the food. I feel calm and grateful. Simple gratitude prayers give me a sense of connection and thanks, whichever faith or none my family follows.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: curiosity, fear, worship
related mind states: gratitude, calm
